localChanges: Four of the six had been true for days — round-trip identity, no-op suppression, the compatibility checks — and a fifth is superseded, since pending effects are entities and the refusal it describes is gone.

The two that remain are named as such: replay equivalence, still blocked because plugins register rules at import so a loaded game has none, and the 150-turn size, which has only ever been measured at turn 12.
